newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian s/adj Feb employment falls 7,200.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian s/adj Feb employment falls 7,200.

text.p: Australia's seasonally adjusted estimate of the number of employed persons fell 7,200 in February to 8.42 million, against 8.43 million in January and 8.33 million a year earlier, the Bureau of Statistics said.

The seasonally adjusted unemployment rate was at 8.8 percent against 8.6 percent in January, compared with 8.4 percent in February 1996. Full-time employment fell 24,200, while part-time employment rose 17,000.
Economists had on average expected employment to rise around 10,000 in February, seasonally-adjusted, with the unemployment rate steady at 8.6 percent.
